user_story: As a user, I want to navigate the multi-level dropdown navigation menu on the JQueryUI page so that I can access various resources. Acceptance criteria: 1. The user should be able to click on 'Enabled' (selector: 'a:contains("Enabled")') and see the submenu items 'Downloads', 'PDF', 'CSV', 'Excel', and 'Back to JQuery UI'. 2. The user should not be able to interact with 'Disabled' (selector: 'li#ui-id-1') and 'Should not see this' (selector: 'li#ui-id-2').
